Every song builds a world

SoundScape

Drop in a song and ride the worlds it builds: a neon city, a roller coaster, a black hole firing lasers, and more. Everything you see moves to your music.

MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC. You can also drag a file anywhere onto this page. The song is read in your browser and never uploaded.

  • Loudnesssets how tall each block grows, so the skyline is the shape of the song.
  • Bass lineis painted on the avenue ahead of you, bar by bar.
  • 12 bandsof the sound drive the city: each column of towers rises and falls with its own frequency, and the cars hop on the beat.
